text:
maya: CI alert - macOS clang build on main is red after the recent toolchain image bump. link errors in //runtime:objc_bridge. anyone else seeing this? cc @eng-infra

ci-bot: buildkite: #build-8245 failed (macos-clang). https://build.example.com/builds/8245 

liam: saw the failure in the pipeline, quick skim looks like missing symbols when linking. attaching snippet.

liam: ```
ld: symbol(s) not found for architecture x86_64
  "_objc_retain", referenced from:
      _OBJC_CLASS_$_ObjcBridge in objc_bridge.o
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
```

sophie: this started after the toolchain roll yesterday? which image did infra switch to?

maya: infra rolled darwin image from clang-14 -> clang-15+libc++-2025. change landed in infra/toolchains#312.

ryan: could be libc++ ABI mismatch. quick check: does the build use -stdlib=libc++ consistently?

liam: bazel build flags show `-stdlib=libc++` for most targets, but objc_bridge is a cc_library that pulls in some prebuilt .o from 3rd_party/objc which were compiled with old stdlib.

maya: hmm. 3rd_party binaries were built months ago. would that break on link with a newer libc++?

liam: yes, if runtime symbols differ. also saw a missing toolchain target error when trying to run locally:

liam: ```
ERROR: /workspace/BUILD:12:1: no such package '@local_config_cc//': The repository '@local_config_cc' could not be resolved: java.io.IOException: Error reading .../cc_toolchain_config
```

sophie: can someone bisect to confirm whether the toolchain bump is the culprit? i can try a local macOS image run but it's slow.

ryan: @maya can we temporarily reroute macos builds to previous image while we triage? even a short pin would reduce noise.

maya: I can pin the pipeline to clang-14 for the macos-clang job. will do if we confirm quickly.

liam: suggestion: bisect main for commits touching infra/toolchains between commit a1b2c3 (before) and d4e5f6 (after). start with `git bisect` on infra repo + kick builds. I can automate via a small script.

ryan: +1 for bisect. also add a rerun for the failed build with `--config=force-old-toolchain` to validate.

ci-bot: @liam started a rerun: buildkite #build-8246 (macos-clang, pinned-old-toolchain) - queued.

liam: rerun came back green with old toolchain. that strongly points at the new image.

sophie: can you paste the bisect range so I can run a few checkpoints locally?

liam: bisect commands I used:
```
git bisect start d4e5f6 a1b2c3
git bisect run ./scripts/run-macos-smoke.sh
```
I hit red on commit 7f9a8b2 which is the image switch and some packaging tweaks.

maya: ok that's decisive. i'll pin macos-clang to previous image and open a rollback PR in infra. also logging an incident: https://incidents.example.com/INC-2026-137

ryan: long-term fix: rebuild 3rd_party/objc artifacts with the new toolchain or migrate away from prebuilt objc objects. we should add a test that links those artifacts against new toolchains in CI.

sophie: agreed. i'll draft a small CI job that builds and links 3rd_party/objc with every candidate toolchain image.

liam: created PR to pin pipeline: infra/pipelines#549 - includes a note and will revert after we rebuild artifacts.

maya: thanks everyone. @ryan @sophie please coordinate on artifact rebuild and a follow-up to remove the pin. i'll monitor build queue and unpin when we validate. :thumbsup:

ryan: will do. starting a rebuild job now.

ci-bot: buildkite: #build-8250 (rebuild-3rd-party-objc) started.

maya: closing the thread for now, will update the incident once we have artifacts rebuilt.

liam: FYI, filed a small postmortem note in #postmortems after we finish.

sophie: copying steps into infra/docs/toolchain-upgrades.md so next roll is smoother.

maya: thanks team.
